title: ECSO ClaimUnit Trajectory Quality Rubric
purpose: Select high-quality clean and local-repair trajectories for SFT without rewarding accidental final-answer success.

hard_gates.name: oracle_isolation
hard_gates.failure: Oracle task text or oracle artifact path is visible to the student trajectory.

hard_gates.name: evidence_reference_and_type_integrity
hard_gates.failure: A verified field cites a missing/fabricated evidence ID, an incompatible evidence kind, or a distractor atom.

hard_gates.name: no_false_closure
hard_gates.failure: An unsupported field or open high-priority obligation is marked verified/stopped.

hard_gates.name: terminal_claim_validity
hard_gates.failure: The final structured claim conflicts with the hidden case oracle.

hard_gates.name: mutation_integrity
hard_gates.failure: The evidence-dropout mutation changes video pixels, oracle fields, or correct claim text at injection time.

hard_gates.name: repair_non_leakage
hard_gates.failure: Repair restores support by reusing the removed evidence ID instead of reacquiring evidence.

criteria.name: terminal_outcome_correctness
criteria.full_credit: Final claim fields match the hidden goal state within case tolerances.

criteria.name: atomic_claim_completeness
criteria.full_credit: All required ClaimUnit fields are present and independently scoreable.

criteria.name: field_evidence_correctness_and_precision
criteria.full_credit: Every field binding covers all required evidence kinds and contains no incompatible/distractor atoms.

criteria.name: field_evidence_completeness
criteria.full_credit: Every verified field has sufficient visible support; no citation-free verified field.

criteria.name: provenance_chain_closure
criteria.full_credit: Every verified field has an action-to-evidence-to-field-to-claim/obligation path.

criteria.name: step_validity_and_order
criteria.full_credit: Required acquisition, binding, proposal, verification, and stop steps occur in a valid dependency order.

criteria.name: obligation_lifecycle_quality
criteria.full_credit: The trajectory explicitly transitions open -> evidence_ready -> proposed -> verified and never skips verification.

criteria.name: subgoal_progress_and_non_regression
criteria.full_credit: Clean progress is monotone; mutation causes an explicit local drop followed by complete recovery.

criteria.name: target_field_sensitivity
criteria.full_credit: All and only fields whose necessary evidence was dropped become unsupported/reopened.

criteria.name: off_target_invariance
criteria.full_credit: Independently supported field values and bindings remain unchanged through mutation and repair.

criteria.name: local_repair_and_recovery
criteria.full_credit: Repair reacquires evidence, restores target bindings, avoids global reset, and returns to the clean goal state.

criteria.name: stop_reflection_efficiency_calibration
criteria.full_credit: The agent performs an explicit final check, stops legally, avoids duplicate work, and uses confidence consistent with evidence quality.

aggregation.accepted_for_sft: all hard gates pass AND total_score >= 95 AND each criterion normalized_score >= 0.8
